fields.label: Key
fields.description: A short name in lower case, for example kavya. It is the guide's address and its id.

fields.label: Area
fields.description: Which of the site's guides does the work: pandit_ji (astrology, Rudraksha, gemstones and poojas), numerologist or dream_guide. The rules, tools and knowledge are the area's; this guide only speaks differently.

fields.label: One line
fields.description: Shown under the name, for example Love and compatibility, in Hinglish.

fields.label: About
fields.description: Two or three lines on how this guide talks and what it helps with. It is an AI guide; say so, and claim no years of experience or credentials.

fields.label: Suits
fields.description: Who it suits, separated by commas, for example Gen Z, Students.

fields.label: Leans toward
fields.description: What it is best at, separated by commas, for example Love, Marriage.

fields.label: How it speaks
fields.description: A few lines the guide is given: its tone, its language, how long its replies are, what it leans toward. The area's own rules, boundaries and tools still apply and cannot be changed here.

fields.label: First line
fields.description: What the guide says when a chat opens, after Hi and the person's name.

fields.label: Picture
fields.description: A portrait, 3:4, head and shoulders. Until one is attached a lettered picture is shown.

fields.label: The picture is AI-made
fields.description: Tick when the picture is made by an AI tool and the person it shows does not exist. It is then labelled on the guide's page.
